criteria.interpretation: 0.0% of state values missing on decision rows.
criteria.next_step: Consider a POMDP/belief-state formulation or explicit missingness indicators; never impute silently.

criteria.question: Question B: Does the dataset support offline RL?
criteria.title: Sampling regularity and fragmentation
criteria.interpretation: Interval CV = 1.45; 91.3% of trajectories contain gaps > 3x median interval.

criteria.question: Question A: Is the problem/formulation appropriate for MDP modelling?
criteria.title: Recorded actions affect the next state (alignment)
criteria.interpretation: Recorded actions carry little information about the next state: No relevant dependence detected (gain = 0.0005 nats [0.0001, 0.0009]; threshold 0.01).
criteria.next_step: If actions should act within one interval, check timestamp alignment of treatments vs. observations and the decision interval.
assumptions: Continuous targets: Gaussian, homoscedastic residuals per dimension (gain = Gaussian conditional mutual information).
